'use strict';

/**
 * Adds two numbers.
 * @param {number} a first operand
 * @param {number} b second operand
 * @returns {number} the sum
 */
function add(a, b) {
  // Validate inputs
  if (typeof a !== 'number' || typeof b !== 'number') {
    throw new TypeError('Both arguments must be numbers.');
  }
  return a + b;
}

module.exports = add;
